title: BioFluid Mix and Transfer - Part 1/2 (API v2)
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the labware on the OT‑2 deck exactly as follows: Slot 1, 4, 7 – custom container holding Nanosep 3K Ultrafiltration tubes; Slot 2, 5, 8 – custom container holding 0.5 mL centrifuge tubes; Slot 3, 6, 9 – custom container holding cryovials with samples; Slot 10 – Temperature Module with a 24‑well aluminum block; Slot 11 – 50/300 µL Opentrons tiprack.

substeps.instruction: Slot 1/4/7: load Nanosep 3K Ultrafiltration tubes.
Slot 2/5/8: load empty 0.5 mL centrifuge tubes.
Slot 3/6/9: load cryovials containing the biofluid samples.
Slot 10: install the Temperature Module and place the 24‑well aluminum block on it.
Slot 11: place the 50/300 µL tiprack.

steps.title: Load reagents on temperature module
steps.instruction: On the aluminum block in Slot 10 add the reagents to the indicated wells: well A1 – Solution 1; wells A2, A3, A4, B1, B2 – Solution 2.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑App, calibrate the tiprack (Slot 11), each custom container (Slots 1‑9), the Temperature Module, and both pipettes – the P300 single‑channel electronic pipette and the P50 single‑channel electronic pipette – following the on‑screen instructions.

substeps.instruction: Run tip calibration for the 50/300 µL tiprack.
Calibrate the positions of the cryovial, centrifuge‑tube, and Nanosep containers.
Calibrate the Temperature Module if a temperature set‑point is required.

steps.title: Distribute biofluids to centrifuge tubes
steps.instruction: Using the P300 single‑channel electronic pipette with a fresh tip, transfer each biofluid sample from its cryovial (Slot 3/6/9) into a corresponding 0.5 mL centrifuge tube (Slot 2/5/8).

substeps.instruction: Pick up a tip from the tiprack.
Aspirate the sample from the cryovial.
Dispense the sample into the empty centrifuge tube.
Eject the used tip.

steps.title: Add Solution 1 to each tube
steps.instruction: Using the P50 single‑channel electronic pipette with a fresh tip, add the required volume of Solution 1 (well A1) to each centrifuge tube containing the transferred biofluid.

steps.title: Add Solution 2 to each tube
steps.instruction: Using the P50 single‑channel electronic pipette with a fresh tip, add the required volume of Solution 2 (wells A2, A3, A4, B1, B2) to each centrifuge tube as specified by the experimental design.

steps.title: Transfer mixture to Nanosep tube
steps.instruction: Using the P300 single‑channel electronic pipette with a fresh tip, move the complete mixture from each centrifuge tube into the matching Nanosep 3K Ultrafiltration tube (Slot 1/4/7).

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new tip.
Aspirate the entire contents of the centrifuge tube.
Dispense into the Nanosep tube.
Eject the tip.

steps.title: Run protocol on OT robot
steps.instruction: In the OT App, input any required protocol parameters, download the generated protocol file, upload it to the robot, and press “Run” to execute the steps.

substeps.instruction: Enter protocol parameters (e.g., volumes, speeds).
Download the protocol script.
Upload the script to the OT‑2.
Press “Run” to start the automated procedure.
